svg.title: zdb replicated compactions: one node merges, uploads to S3 and returns a manifest update; the leader proposes it through Raft and every replica applies it
svg.desc: Three replicas hold the same forest. The leader picks an L0 to L1 compaction and asks follower 1 to run it. Follower 1 merges files f6, f7, f4 and f5, uploads the new files f8 and f9 to S3, and returns a manifest update listing the files removed and added. The leader proposes the update through Raft, every replica applies it, and all three forests are identical, with only one node having done the merge.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: ZDB · REPLICATED COMPACTIONS · ONE NODE MERGES, EVERY REPLICA APPLIES THE RESULT
